share.title: Share this chat
share.description: Scan the QR code or share the link below

ghostly.theirDefault: What they show you by default
ghostly.nameAsSaid: Name and picture as they sent them; they are not a proof.
ghostly.explain: Your Ghostly identity is what contacts see unless you share another: your name and picture, and a key pair made for each chat, so no key ties your chats together.
ghostly.keysHint: Open a chat's Identities to see the key it uses there.
ghostly.hintSees: {{contact}} sees your Ghostly identity, {{name}}, and this chat's key {{key}}.
ghostly.doneOnly: Only your Ghostly identity is shared
ghostly.addHint: Prove that you hold a Nostr key, a domain or an account, then show it to the contacts you choose, one chat at a time.
ghostly.chosenChats: Shown only in the chats you choose
ghostly.verifiedExplain: You compared codes with them: their key is the one you verified.
ghostly.notVerifiedExplain: You have not compared codes with them yet; the chat's connection panel offers it.

did.title: Public DID
did.hint: An identifier for this profile that anyone can look up (a W3C DID, did:dht). It has a key of its own: no chat uses it, so it ties none of them together.
did.published: Published {{time}}. It goes out again every hour while the app runs.
did.offline: Not published while the network is off.
did.failed: Could not publish: {{error}}. Trying again in a few minutes.
did.listTitle: List identities publicly in my DID
did.warning: Anything listed here is public to everyone, for good: anyone with your DID sees it, and some resolvers keep copies even after you take it out. Chats never need it. Leave these off to share each identity with one contact at a time.
did.none: No identity to list yet. Nostr keys, domains, OpenPGP keys, Bitcoin addresses and GitHub or GitLab accounts can be listed once you add them.
did.expired: Expired: not listed until you renew it

profileSwitcher.title: Switch profile
profileSwitcher.holdHint: Or hold Settings in the tab bar

slow.answering: Still exchanging keys with your contact…

reason.offline: You are offline. Pairing goes on once you are back online.
reason.transport: No direct link could be opened between your devices.
reason.rejected: Your contact's app refused the connection.
reason.keyMismatch: This contact's key does not match the saved one. Nothing was accepted.
